pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with highly serrated, crenellated margins showing sharp pixel gradients at the interface. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, with larger regions on the flank and smaller, more compressed regions toward the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a reticulated mesh. Junction nodes are typically trivalent or quadrivalent. Pixel thickness of corridors is relatively uniform, displaying a diffuse, fibrous transition into the dark patch borders.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense, upright bristly silhouette along the dorsal neck. Characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude geometric projections against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple localized, small, circular nodules and textural disruptions present across the upper flank and mid-dorsal region, appearing as raised, darker pigmented spots.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the posterior dorsal region near the rump.
